name: Walled City of Baku with the Shirvanshah's Palace and Maiden Tower
description: Baku's Old City, Icheri Sheher, is a maze of narrow lanes and minarets on the Caspian shore of Azerbaijan, still partly ringed by its 12th-century walls. Its landmarks are the stout, round Maiden Tower, which rises over far older foundations and has a rooftop with sweeping views of the bay, and the 15th-century Shirvanshahs' Palace, a graceful complex of the region's former rulers.
